title: Humanize Orchestrates Multi-Agent Coding via Deterministic Gates and Cross-Vendor Review
summary: Humanize is a multi-agent orchestration workflow that replaces probabilistic model routing with 72 deterministic hooks to enforce mechanical boundaries between planning, implementation, and review. By alternating builder and reviewer samples across different model vendors, defects only survive if both models fail to catch them.

whyItMatters.text: Enforces 72 deterministic gates and a phase-separated workflow where two-thirds of rounds occur after initial implementation approval.
Combines multi-vendor model sampling to reduce single-model blind spots in agentic coding loops.
Demonstrated strong results across benchmarks, including top-three finishes in MLSys 2026 FlashInfer and full scores in IOI and PutnamBench.

articles.headline: NVIDIA PivotOPD Trains Multi-Turn AI Agents to Recover From Pivotal Mistakes
articles.summary: NVIDIA researchers introduced PivotOPD, an on-policy distillation method that trains multi-turn LLM agents to detect and recover from early pivotal mistakes. The training framework combines reverse KL for prevention and forward KL for recovery, adding zero overhead at inference time.
key_takeaways: Recovers from 72.7% of replayed pivotal mistakes compared to 20.3% for standard on-policy distillation.
Adds zero inference cost while outperforming 13 baselines across ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-based QA.
Addresses the critical blind spot in outcome-based RL where early errors cause group-relative advantages to flatline at zero.

articles.headline: Perplexity AI Releases pplx-embed-v2-late ColBERT Embeddings for Multimodal Search
articles.summary: Perplexity has launched pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of ColBERT-style multimodal embedding models available in 0.6B edge and 9B datacenter sizes. Both models output 128-dimensional vectors per token and utilize MaxSim scoring to enable direct visual document search without OCR steps.
key_takeaways: Features a 0.6B model optimized for local edge deployment and a 9B model that scores 92.4% on MADQA.
Maintains a shared embedding space allowing lightweight 0.6B queries to efficiently search a 9B document index.
Uses 128-dim token vectors that are significantly narrower than traditional dense models while supporting text, images, and page renders.

articles.headline: Architect Launches Liquid Inference to Run Real-Time Auctions for LLM Requests
articles.summary: Architect Financial Technologies has released Liquid Inference, an exchange-style LLM router that auctions every API request to competing providers. Buyers can set strict constraints including per-job cost caps, latency limits, and zero data retention while retaining drop-in compatibility with standard clients.
key_takeaways: Runs live auctions where the lowest qualifying provider bid wins the prompt routing.
Provides drop-in compatibility for OpenAI and Anthropic clients, including coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
Locks maximum pricing before generation and exposes live order books and cleared transactions.

tool_of_the_day.headline: AdaGuard Implements Adaptive Reasoning-Budget Allocation for LLM Guardrails
tool_of_the_day.summary: AdaGuard is an adaptive LLM-as-a-Judge framework that dynamically infers input complexity to balance latency and safety compliance. Trained via supervised fine-tuning and GRPO, it switches between high-speed inference and reasoning-enabled moderation at runtime.

title: Auxiliary-Loss-Free Balancing in Mixture-of-Experts
summary: DeepSeek-V3 introduces dynamic bias adjustment to prevent expert collapse without gradient contamination.
takeaway: Preserves core reasoning gradients without auxiliary loss penalties.

title: Context-Free Grammar Enforcement at Token Level in vLLM
summary: Pushdown automaton state tracking restricts logits masks during decoding, guaranteeing RFC 8259 compliance.
takeaway: Zero schema retries in autonomous agent structured tool-calling loops.
